theorems.name: Submission.classical_tangent_support_flatness
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (S : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (a ρ₀ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < a → 0 < ρ₀ → (∀ ζ ∈ S ∩ closedBall x ρ₀, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ₀ → a * s ^ n ≤ μ.real (closedBall ζ s)) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * μ.real (closedBall x ρ \ {y | infDist (y - x) (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) < ε * ρ})) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ sSup ((fun y ↦ ρ⁻¹ * infDist (y - x) (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ))) '' (S ∩ closedBall x ρ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
